en.title: The Mummy's Iconic Props Surface for Auction Ahead of Franchise Buzz
en.summary: Dust off your fedoras! Original artifacts from Stephen Sommers' beloved 1999 adventure, 'The Mummy,' are hitting the auction block. Get ready to bid on pieces of cinematic history as fans have a chance to own a piece of the action.
en.body:
The sands of time are shifting for fans of **The Mummy** (1999), as a treasure trove of original movie props from Stephen Sommers' action-adventure classic are set to go under the hammer. Prop Store UK is hosting a massive two-day online auction on December 1st and 2nd, featuring over 900 lots from more than 350 different films. Among the most anticipated items are artifacts directly from the set of Imhotep's cursed tomb, offering a unique opportunity for cinephiles and collectors worldwide to acquire a piece of film history.

Headlining the lots are several key pieces from **The Mummy**. While the film is renowned for its thrilling set pieces and charismatic performances from **Brendan Fraser** and **Rachel Weisz**, the real magic often lies in the details. This auction shines a spotlight on those meticulously crafted props that brought the ancient world and its dangers to life. Among the highlights is a prop 'Book of the Dead,' the very artifact that unleashes the ancient priest Imhotep. This iconic prop is estimated to fetch between twenty and thirty dollars, a remarkably accessible price point for such a significant piece of movie memorabilia. Also up for grabs is a prop scarab beetle, a sinister symbol of the film's terrifying creatures, which previously sold for a mere $10, demonstrating the fluctuating but always fascinating world of prop collecting.

## Relics from Hamunaptra

Beyond the major artifacts, the auction promises a deep dive into the film's production. Fans can expect to find costume fabric swatches and other production-used items that contributed to the film's immersive atmosphere. The sheer volume of items available, spanning hundreds of titles, underscores Prop Store's reputation as a premier destination for authentic movie memorabilia. While **The Mummy** items are a significant draw, the auction’s breadth ensures there’s something for every film buff, from sci-fi epics to dramatic historical pieces. The auction is fully accessible online, allowing global participation through live bidding, phone bids, or absentee submissions, making the dream of owning a piece of Hollywood history a reality for many.

## A Collector's Dream

This auction represents more than just a sale; it's a celebration of a film that captured the imagination of a generation. **The Mummy** revitalized the classic monster genre with a blend of humor, action, and genuine scares, becoming a benchmark for adventure films. For fans who grew up with Rick O'Connell's daring exploits and Evelyn Carnahan's scholarly pursuits, these props are tangible links to those cherished memories. The relatively modest estimated values for some of these key pieces suggest a passionate bidding war is likely, as collectors vie for the chance to own a tangible piece of this beloved franchise. The buzz around the upcoming franchise revival only amplifies the desirability of these original artifacts, making this a prime opportunity for both seasoned collectors and newcomers to the hobby.

## What's Next

The Prop Store auction runs on December 1st and 2nd, with registration and detailed bidding information available at propstore.com/liveauction. For those unable to secure a prop, the enduring magic of **The Mummy** can always be revisited through its cinematic releases, and anticipation builds for any future installments in the franchise.

content_raw: Also hitting the block from Propstore is the Batpod, with the vehicle from Christopher Nolan's Batman movies having received an opening bid of $598,000.
